description: This file defines the CandidateStatusAPI class, which provides an API endpoint to list all candidate statuses in the recruitment module of OrangeHRM. It extends a base Endpoint class, implements CollectionEndpoint, and uses traits for vacancy services and internationalization helpers. The main method getAll() retrieves candidate status data, maps internal status codes to localized labels, and returns the data as an API response.
